newsitem.title: UK: Lehman names debt/insurance director in London.
newsitem.headline: Lehman names debt/insurance director in London.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said on Monday it had appointed Eric Briys as a new director and insurance industry specialist in its London fixed income research department.

Briys, formerly finance and economics professor at the Hautes Etudes Commerciales in Paris, will be responsible for developing Lehman's European insurance industry business, the bank said in a statement.
Briys will also head Lehman's activities in insurance risk management within the bank's derivative marketing group.
